name: backgrounds-v2
goal: 배경 전면 재발주 (10테마) — 무대 정합성(ADR-009): 알바(작업자) 1인칭 시점, 화면 하단 40~45%는 게임 오브젝트가 '놓이는' 빈 작업 표면. 구세대(손님 시점 풍경, order#2·4)는 오브젝트가 공중에 떠 보여 반려됨.
style: bold clean dark outlines on foreground shapes, vibrant but slightly desaturated palette so gameplay objects pop, energetic comic cartoon style, flat cel shading
common: portrait 1024x1536 game background, first-person view from the WORKER's position at their station. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: the bottom 40-45% of the frame is one continuous EMPTY work surface seen at a gentle downward angle (like looking down at your own counter), completely clean and uncluttered so game objects can sit on it; the shop context fills the upper half with soft, low-contrast detail; consistent warm lighting; no text, no watermark, no people, no hands

items.label: 김밥집 주방
items.subject: the prep station inside a korean snack diner kitchen from the worker's view: lower half is an empty stainless-and-wood prep counter, upper half shows ingredient containers, rice cooker and kitchen shelves in soft detail

items.label: 초밥집 도마
items.subject: a sushi chef's station from the chef's own view: lower half is an empty pale hinoki wood cutting counter, upper half shows the quiet dark-teal restaurant interior and hanging lanterns in soft detail

items.label: 카페 바 안쪽
